## Screenshots — required for screen/UI changes

Complete this checklist and include captures in this description **before
requesting review**, including after updates. If capture is blocked, explain
the blocker and keep the PR in draft.

- [ ] Real screenshots of the running app cover every modified screen and
      relevant changed UI state; no mockups.
- [ ] Mobile and desktop captures are included when applicable; any omitted
      viewport is explained.
- [ ] Existing screens have labeled before/after captures when feasible;
      otherwise explain why only after captures are available.
- [ ] Captures are embedded below or linked for reviewer access, labeled with
      route, viewport dimensions and UI state.
- [ ] Captures use test or anonymized data and have been inspected: no personal
      information, credentials or tokens, including in URLs, browser chrome or
      developer tools.

For changes with no rendered UI impact, leave the screenshot checklist
unchecked and write: `Not applicable — no screens changed`.
